Asha: Quick call — need to lock a webinar topic and run-of-show for late May. Short list and clear demo required.
Liam: Vote for model routing + graceful degradation. Practical, measurable, buyers care.
Priya: Agreed. We should include a token-cost slide and clear playbook.
Sam: Speaker plan: Noor for live demo, Raj for architecture, Carlos for customer impact. Docs person for playbook.
Diego: Mei is OOO last week of May; Noor can cover demo if she9s good with the scripted failure. Pre-record fallback.
Noor: I can demo. Need a dev snapshot with KV caching + a small quantized fallback model. Will need 25m live + 10m backup video.
Liam: Audience = mid-market platform teams and engineers evaluating SLAs. CTA = gated dedicated eval + runbook download.
Priya: I9ll prepare 3 prompt scenarios: cache-heavy long-context, latency-sensitive assistant, region failover. Also token-cost comparisons.
Sam: Draft run-of-show (45m):
00:00-05:00 Intro & why it matters (Asha)
05:00-25:00 Live failure-injection demo (Noor)
25:00-35:00 Architecture + routing logic (Raj)
35:00-43:00 Playbook + migration checklist (Docs)
43:00-45:00 Quick Q&A + CTA
Diego: Rehearsals: full dry-run 24h prior (45m), greenroom 15m before, and a 10m backup recording.
Noor: For infra: if eng-runtime can snapshot, great. Otherwise I9ll emulate locally. Command I9m using: ./provision_demo.sh --snapshot=canary --kv=true --small-model=true
eng-runtime: We can spin a short-lived test pool. Ping with exact config and window.
Liam: Abstract draft: "Resilient model routing: keep LLM features online during faults and spikes. Live failure-injection demo + a reproducible playbook." I9ll post two headline options by Tue.
Sam: I9ll produce a rehearsal checklist (audio, bandwidth, demo keys), an ops runbook, and attendee triage doc for Q&A.
Asha: Owners: Liam = copy & landing page, Priya = prompts & slides, Sam = ops & rehearsals, Noor = demo infra + video. Diego = speaker scheduling.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Webinar — Resilient Model Routing" Thu May 23 10:00 PDT. Guests: marketing, runtime, product, docs. :calendar:
Asha: Great. Add blockers here and tag owners. :thumbsup:
